name: Crossover Adventures
source: What happens when magicians mix up portals and worlds collide? Enjoy this fun and chaotic crossover between THE ARCANA and LAST LEGACY! Meet characters from both stories, and see where their world-spanning misadventures take them.
translation: What happens when magicians mix up portals and worlds collide? Enjoy this fun and chaotic crossover between THE ARCANA and LAST LEGACY! Meet characters from both stories, and see where their world-spanning misadventures take them.
